titulo: Clúster Sur: a seismic observatory that shows how it recovers from a failure
resumen: A public observatory on GitHub Pages using a historical USGS earthquake catalog: a map, charts and filters, plus a view showing how two computers shared the work and what happened when one disconnected. This is not real-time monitoring or prediction.
entregable: A public URL with a map, filters, charts and a failure log, producing the same result as the reference calculation.

datos.licencia: Public domain (United States), with credits to the seismic networks

alt: Students review seismograms and maps while computers across Latin America share tasks, with one computer disconnected
altPlano: Clúster Sur blueprint: data, distribution, recovery and presentation

org: Creative Commons Venezuela y Creative Commons Switzerland
titulo: Mapa vivo: discover and improve educational spaces within Wikimedia
resumen: A shareable interactive map and table, built with Wikidata Query Service, of science museums and planetariums in a country or area of Latin America. A Wikidata work page brings them together with 5 to 10 proposed improvements, each with its QID and an independent source.
entregable: A shareable map and table, a Wikidata entry page and 5 to 10 verifiable proposals; places without coordinates remain visible in the table.
alt: People with maps, books and laptops mark museums and planetariums on a map of Latin America, with incomplete records to fill in
altPlano: Mapa vivo blueprint: query, verify, visualize and connect

titulo: Archivo Abierto: recover scientific and cultural heritage using OCR and human review
resumen: A small digital exhibition based on 5 to 10 pages from Memorias de la Sociedad Científica «Antonio Alzate» (Mexico, 1887–1888, public domain): OCR with Tesseract in GitHub Actions, human review of at least two pages, search, side-by-side reading and a downloadable package documenting its provenance. Teams may propose another source if they demonstrate that its rights are open.
entregable: A searchable website with the image, OCR and corrected text side by side, plus a versioned package of images, texts and metadata.

datos.nombre: Memorias de la Sociedad Científica «Antonio Alzate», volume 1 (Wikimedia Commons)

alt: Three students compare an old book with its recognized text on screen; arrows in the background lead from image to OCR to website
altPlano: Archivo Abierto blueprint: select, recognize, review and publish

titulo: Del kit al impacto: open data to expand an educational initiative
resumen: A real initiative prepared 600 educational kits in Caracas and La Guaira. By October 10, it had delivered 509 and received 60 drawings. Create a mobile dashboard with inventory, verified deliveries, a map at a safe scale and authorized photographs. Also propose how a human jury could assess anonymous drawings and select ten to receive an expanded kit. Sensitive records remain private; the jury prototype uses synthetic examples.
entregable: A public dashboard with dated figures, reconciliation, a map of publishable deliveries and an exportable report; a restricted jury workflow prototype with a rubric and traceable decisions.

datos.licencia: CC0 for structured data; images subject to individual permission

alt: University volunteers prepare art kits and review aggregate indicators and a general map, without showing children
altPlano: Del kit al impacto blueprint: deliveries, public map, authorized photographs, restricted jury and privacy

org: Dirección de Ambiente · Municipalidad de Villa Yacanto de Calamuchita
titulo: AmbientIA: discover environmental matches between communities in Latin America and the Caribbean
resumen: What if a community could find another, in a different country, with a comparable landscape or environmental challenge? Choose a locality and explore explainable matches: watershed, climate, population, urban expansion or land cover, depending on available data. The prototype will show on a map why they are similar, how they differ and what information is missing. Environmental and local knowledge guide the questions; education, journalism and design make comparisons useful; technical skills build the method.
entregable: A public app or dashboard to select a community and explore matches in another country, with a map, visual comparison, reproducible method and sources; a well-documented sample is enough.

datos.nombre: BasinATLAS v1.0 (environmental baseline; combine with GeoNames and GHSL)
datos.licencia: CC BY 4.0; attribute every source used

alt: An interdisciplinary team compares maps of two Latin American communities: rivers, mountains, forests, population and local differences
altPlano: AmbientIA blueprint: scope communities, profile indicators, compare similarities and explain differences and missing data
